info.title: MICROSERVICE-apiwizruntimedoc-List Pharmacy Prescriptions Deliverys-v5-spec
info.description: The Pharmacy Prescriptions Delivery API enables users to access detailed information regarding the delivery status of prescriptions from various pharmacies. This API provides essential data such as delivery timelines, pharmacy locations, and order statuses. Typical consumers include pharmacy staff, healthcare providers, and patients tracking their prescriptions. By utilizing this API, users can efficiently manage and monitor prescription deliveries, enhancing the overall healthcare experience.

get.description: This endpoint allows users to retrieve information about the delivery status of their prescriptions. It provides detailed insights into the expected delivery timeline and current status, ensuring users are informed about their medication delivery.

requestBody.description: Request body containing the necessary information to retrieve prescription delivery details.

201.description: The request was successful, and the prescription delivery has been initiated.
